additionalRules: A Fords of Isen Army may have up to 50% of its Warrior models armed with throwing spears rather than the usual 33%.
A Fords of Isen Army must always contain Théodred, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: Protect the Prince
specialRules.text: Friendly models gain the Sworn Protector (Théodred) special rule.

specialRules.name: Resolute Rohirrim
specialRules.text: If your Army is Broken, friendly models gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

specialRules.name: The Courage of Elfhelm
specialRules.text: If Théodred is Engaged in Combat within 6" of Elfhelm, then enemy models may not make Strikes against Théodred if there is another model they could make Strikes against instead.

specialRules.name: Reckless Charge
specialRules.text: When Théodred Moves, he must always Charge an enemy model if possible. Additionally, in a turn in which Théodred Charges he must re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

units.name: Captain of Rohan
options: Exchange armour for heavy armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
specialRules.text: Elfhelm never suffers the -1 penalty for Moving and Shooting when using his throwing Spear. Additionally, when throwing his throwing Spear, Elfhelm may re-roll any failed To Hit, To Wound or In The Way Rolls when making that shooting attack.

specialRules.name: Mighty Blow
specialRules.text: For each Strike that successfully Wounds in close combat, this model inflicts 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector
specialRules.text: Models with this special rule will have a specific model in brackets after the special rule. Whilst the named model is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If this model is within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, then it gains a bonus of +1 to its Fight Value in a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Spear Mastery
specialRules.text: This model may use its throwing Spear as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it in either the preceding Move Phase or Shoot Phase.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.text: This model may benefit from a friendly Hero model's Stand Fast regardless of range.
